'''Balionn-Gur''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Balionn-Gur conquered a [[Balionn-Gur's planet|planet]] and, out of a desire to rule through law and order rather than fear, hired [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] to reassure the populace of his intentions, allowing him to establish order without violence.
